logp.method_description: Lipophilicity for the complexes has been determined by “shake flask” method between octanol/water phase partitions [2]. Solutions of 1-5 (1 mg/mL) have been prepared in double distilled water and octanol separately and diluted to various concentrations as 2, 4, 6, 8, 10, μg/mL for the lipophilicity measurement. The absorbance of 1-5 in both solutions (water and octanol) has been determined and used to draw the calibration curve. Triplicate experiments have been performed for each complex. Further, an appropriate amount of 1-5 (2 mg/mL) has been shaken in 1:1 water and octanol solution for 24 h. At the equilibrium, organic and aqueous layers have been separated. Finally, the concentration of drugs (1-5) in each phase has been determined by UVvis spectral studies and used for the calculation of log P using the equation log P = log [(1-5)oct/ (1-5)aq] [3].
